text: ＊　つつんでいた　しんぴの　ベールが　なくなった！

structure.jp: ＊　つつんでいた　しんぴの　ベールが
structure.en: the mystical veil that was wrapping ＊

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つつんでいた　しんぴの　ベール
patterns.explanation: The verb phrase sits before ベール and describes it; the を after ＊ is dropped. つつんでいた　しんぴの　ベール = 'the mystical veil that had been wrapping (it)'

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた says something was going on over a stretch of time in the past. つつんでいた = 'had been wrapping'
